QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_37

question.text: If an investor remains dissatisfied with the AIF's initial Action Taken Report (ATR) on SCORES, the investor can request a FIRST REVIEW within:

answer.text: 60 calendar days of receiving the ATR
15 calendar days of receiving the ATR
30 calendar days of receiving the ATR
7 calendar days of receiving the ATR

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Circular Sep 20, 2023: investors can request First Review within 15 CALENDAR days of receiving the ATR. The Designated Body then uploads its ATR within 10 days. Second Review: again within 15 days of the revised ATR. SEBI's own review follows. The Trap: 7/30/60 days are distractors. The 15-day window is tight — ensure operations team responds fast. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the review mechanism. Manager's Pro-Tip: Train your investor-services team to treat every First-Review trigger as an escalation — the investor's dissatisfaction has now been logged with SEBI. Provide a second-look by senior manager or compliance head before ATR upload.
